mapper.select: SELECT user_managed_groups.powtoon_group_code, user_managed_groups.user_id as managed_group_user_id, user_managed_groups.created_time as managed_group_created_time, user_managed_groups.updated_time as managed_group_updated_time, groups.powtoon_group_code as group_powtoon_group_code, groups.name as group_name, groups.powtoon_parent_group_code as group_powtoon_parent_group_code, groups.master_id as group_master_id, groups.created_time as group_created_time, groups.updated_time as group_updated_time FROM user_managed_groups JOIN groups ON user_managed_groups.powtoon_group_code = groups.powtoon_group_code AND groups.master_id = #{masterId} WHERE user_managed_groups.user_id = #{userId}
